Convert "ts-boxable" objects to tslist (extension of tsbox::ts_tslist())

conv_tslist.Rd

Convert "ts-boxable" objects to tslist (extension of tsbox::ts_tslist())

Usage

conv_tslist(x)

Arguments

x

a "ts-boxable" object to be converted

Value

returns an object as a tslist.

Details

This function performs a similar operation to tsbox::ts_tslist(). It converts ts-boxable objects to the tslist format. An important difference compared with tsbox::ts_tslist() is that the x argument of conv_tslist() can be a wide tbl.

Examples

quarterly_data_example |>
  conv_xts() |>
  conv_tslist() |>
  names() |>
  head()
#> [1] "E_NF_HI"    "ECT_HI"     "EMN_HI"     "EWT_HI"     "ERT_HI"    
#> [6] "E_TRADE_HI"
quarterly_data_example |>
  conv_wide() |>
  conv_tslist() |>
  utils::str(list.len = 2)
#> List of 30
#>  $ E_NF_HI     : Time-Series [1:109] from 1998 to 2025: 531 531 533 531 530 ...
#>  $ ECT_HI      : Time-Series [1:109] from 1998 to 2025: 23.3 23 23 23.1 22.8 ...
#>   [list output truncated]
#>  - attr(*, "class")= chr [1:2] "tslist" "list"
quarterly_data_example |>
  tsbox::ts_long() |>
  tsbox::ts_pick("E_NF_HI") |>
  conv_wide() |>
  conv_tslist()
